notes.title: Panther VR Security Update now Available - Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/8fa0e85f1e5319632dcea335f050012ce43f3e9f.png[/img]

[h1]A much-needed rework for Panther VR![/h1]

Hope you are all doing great! With great pleasure and after a lot of work. We finally can give you the new Security update 0.1.2 for Panther VR. The last interaction update brought a lot of reworks and mechanics that changed the basic feel of the game, but this Security update will be even bigger. This new update does include a massive rework on stealth and Alert systems, big Guards AI/interaction improvements that fully transform the whole experience of the game to the next level. These new features will enhance stealth gameplay and will make your decisions even more interesting and important. No longer will your game “end’ when you are detected. You can now always break line of sight and guards will no longer be all-seeing entities, making it possible to reset, learn and continue playing after a mistake. 

Manage your health with the new Health system. Try to make the most out of your sneaking skills with the new Lockpicking system and by completing the new Stealth bonus objectives. Takedown guards with a Dartgun with the new Non-lethal system and hide them away in the new Lockers and crates before they trace you down with the new Point of interest system. 

As you might hear there are some big changes includes in this update that we are excited about. It did take some extra work and time to make. But we truly believe that Panther VR is getting closer and closer to the game that we envisioned, and this update is the next big step. With the next update on the horizon (Progression) there will be even more to look forward to like new weapons, mechanics, levels, and a full progression system with levels, resources, and unlocks. 

We can’t wait to hear what you think of this!

Enjoy!

[b]-Jesse[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/eac953063f25fa7fa0e831f792a9571fd81dc3c5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]Why did it take longer than expected?[/h1]

We already shared these points last time, but we think it is always important to share with you why things might progress slower than other games. [b]One thing is sure: we are very dedicated to this project so we will keep going till the end. It is a big project build by fans of stealth, we want the best just like you, but we have limited time with 2 people working on it. Not even mention the small number of resources we can spend on this.[/b] We can only hope that you will take this into consideration. Help us to support the game by getting a copy on steam, or just by spreading the word or joining the community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]
[h1]Future Content[/h1]

[h3]Changes in Roadmap[/h3]
We are changing up our timeline to increase our focus on the goal of the game. While most of the systems are in place, we are still missing a progression system to make it all worth it.  That is why we are moving the Progression update forward instead of the contracts update. 

[h3]New Levels[/h3]
We are getting some questions about when or if we will be adding new Levels. We have some good news: that new levels/game modes will be added in the coming updates. The main reason why we haven’t added any levels yet is that we wanted to focus (our already limited time) on the core mechanics of the game. If the core is not up to standard then the game is still lacking, even with 100 different levels. So we focus our effort on getting the core mechanics right in this main level, and with the random level generation that is already present, this level is different and unique each time you play. 

We want to add many more levels and game modes to the game. First up will be contracts mode: a randomly generated “dungeon” like system, just like you might see in our other game, VR Dungeon Knight.  So we can’t wait to show you more. We also want to look at more open levels like the one that is present in the game. 

[url=http://www.wolfdoginteractive.com/panther-vr-roadmap/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f48a4a570dd8dba402bfe5fa6185e464c411efe9.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Coming up next: 0.1.3 Progression Update [/h3]
The progression update will add a lot of new stuff to the game that lets you unlock by completing missions and gaining exp/money. We have some new weapons and customization coming up to spice up your gameplay. Level up and spend points to unlock new abilities. Collect data drives and new items to upgrade weapons and gadgets. And track all your stats to see if you are the ultimate thief.

[b][list]
[*] Progression and level up system
[*] Data drives and new collectibles
[*] New Weapons and customization
[*] Skill and abilities 
[*] Stats and tracking
[*] More to come!
[/list][/b]

[h3]Preview of the new weapons in update 0.1.3[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/73ca2ce2e80effe02fbc2c642aeda9bd5aa918e6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/be1d6c264632ba6f53d978fa72d36b3ad7f79e10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/0236d494bea2d66e2fa105ff4dca9de4f6849dce.png[/img]

[h1]Added: New Alert/Stealth System [REWORK] [/h1]
At the core of the Security update lies the Reworked alert and stealth system. It is a full redesign of the old systems that brings familiar stealth mechanics to Panther VR. This system is the core of the game, so we think this is one of the most important and game-changing reworks we did to this date. In order to highlight what is new in the update let’s take a look at the old version.

[h3]Old system[/h3]
In the old system, stealth was really fragile, unforgiving, and linear. You start the mission in full stealth with guards unaware of your initial presents. This is where it went right, but the moment you were seen by a guard or camera, it goes to red alert and it ends there. All the guards despawned and SWAT stormed the place, making it impossible to return to a stealth game, essentially ending the loop. Guards and SWAT never truly lost you out of sight and tracked you down like an all-seeing entity. The tiniest mistake (or bug) could mean a failure to the mission. 

[h3]New System[/h3]
A proper stealth game should have a loop that can reset itself and always give the player the ability to break the line of sight and re-enter stealth.  This is exactly what we did in this new rework. As you can see in the schematics below, we added a whole new layer of depth to the alert system and made sure it has the possibility to reset the loop.

Alert does not stay forever anymore and instead of SWAT and special Assault team will be sent in to support the remaining guards. If the security forces lose sight of the player for some time, the Alert status will be lowered to Searching. In this state, all guards will remain vigilant. Once they spot the player again, the alert will be raised to Red, but if they still cannot find you after a set time, the loop will be reset and guards will return to their normal patrols. 

[h3]Watch[/h3]
We’ve also added a watch on the left hand (can be switched) to indicate the current Alert status of the Level, and how long it will take before the status will be lowered. In combination with other visual and audio queues, you can always track the alert status of the Level and Guards

[b]Functionality:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ability to rehide[/b] 
[*] [b]Allert system can reset[/b] 
[*] [b]Break line of sight[/b] 
[*] [b]Guards and Overall Alert status are separated [/b] 
[/list]

[h3]Open in new tab to see old system:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3e63d847e7c7f4287e0feb301e2e230de20cfbcc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/664a50f1c31199a84a32b1a295fd5f8eb611f3c9.png[/img]

[h1]Added: New Guards and AI system[/h1]

Besides the Alert and Stealth system, guards will also be receiving a full makeover. We have completely rebuild the AI system adding more depth and intelligence to the guards. They are more aware of their surroundings and they will work together in combat and detection. We have reworked their detection system: you can distract them with sound, they will investigate your presents and traces and they will call for backup if needed, which might be answered by the new Assualt team.   

In addition to their behavior, we also changed their appearance and gave them a voice. We have improved their visual looks and each guard is now uniquely generated and has more personality than before. 

[h3]More to come[/h3]
Keep in mind that making an AI system is the most difficult part of any game. This update will be a complete 180 of what it was, but bugs and issues might still happen. You see it even in the biggest of games where enemies might get stuck. AI in an open world can experience an unlimited amount of variables and options. We tried to iron out the most obvious ones, but know that we will always keep improving the AI in a future update. So help us out by reporting any issues you might find. 


[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Whole new AI system[/b]
[*] [b]More interaction with guards[/b]
[*] [b]Seperate alert sytem[/b]
[*] [b]Visuall overhaul[/b]
[*] [b]Random ppearance dom [/b]
[*] [b]Added Voicelines [/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/bf038013eca58ec38fcf6878d633ff20b582e194.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/208385cab1da460bf4069fa86f755cdc311fec8a.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Point of Interest/ Last seen Location [/h1]

New to this Security update is the addition of the Point of Interest system. This system serves as an extension to the AI system and works as a visual indicator for the player. During the heist, the player can leave traces behind, and leaving as many traces as possible is important for a thief. Now you can easily track what might be of interest to guards and how they are going to respond to them. Now those broken cameras and bodies you leave behind have consequences for your results in the mission. The Point of interest includes the following parts:

[h3]Last seen location[/h3]
A must-have for stealth games and finally present is the Last seen Player location. This marker will show the last seen/know location of you for the guards. This location will also be present and will serve as a place of higher investigation for guards. Keep in mind that both guards and cameras will share and create a last known location when you are in their sights. If you are in combat the Last seen location will be the point where you broke the line of sight.

[h3]Noise Distraction[/h3]
Distracting a guard by making noise has made its comeback to the game. By throwing items, shooting the wall, or by running, you create noise that might be further investigated by a nearby guard. 

[h3]Trace indicators[/h3]
When you leave a body or broken security system behind, you also leave traces that can be found by guards. These traces are now indicated by a red or yellow icon. Yellow traces like security sytem will put a guard in an investigative position, but finding a body will even raise the alarm. Event messages show up when a body or broken system has been found by security forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/397f2e202081ba607389d0ee0248630349457d29.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/657dfbdb16a7531b5448b64eb592456f352b97c8.png[/img]

[h1]Added: New Health Sytem[/h1]

This update brings some big changes to the Health system. While you used to automatically self-heal over time without taking damage, this rework brings a set health pool and the ability to heal yourself with a syringe, healing stations, and items. This new system brings a whole new approach to the game, making the player much more vulnerable and increases the value of stealth. 

You can view your health status on your new wristband. When you take damage from guards, security systems, etc, your health will not auto regenerate over time. You will need to heal yourself.

One of the different ways you can heal yourself is with the use of a syringe. The syringe is always part of your basic kit and has its own new slot located on your arm with the watch. You can grab the syringe with an empty hand. Once held you can stab the syringe in your other hand or straight up in your body/chest to heal yourself. The syringe will have a limited amount of charges. However, those charges can be recharged at a healing station. 

[b]Details[/b] 

[list]
[*] [b]Added Set amount of Health[/b]
[*] [b]Added Health information Tracker on wrist [/b]
[*] [b]Added Syringe to heal yourself[/b]
[*] [b]Added Health items to heal yourself[/b]
[/list]

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2910970981466403299]Panther VR - Dev Blog 8# [New Weapons System][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/123838b86017370d6bb27a97d5ddf52b9ce7c9e6.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Non-Lethal[/h1]
With this update, it is now possible to make Non-lethal takedowns. Whack guards on the head with a melee weapon and they will fall unconscious on the floor. Unconscious guards will show Zzz above their head, and they do not count towards your kill amount. You still need to hide you, knockout guard, before they are found by other guards.

[h3]Melee weapons[/h3]
You can use blunt weapons (orange), like a baseball bat, a crowbar, or a pipe for a non-lethal takedown. Sharp weapons (red), like knives, scissors, and axes will still kill guards. It is now also possible to whip a guard with the butt of your pistol or rifle. 

[h3]Fists[/h3]
In case you run out of bullets or anything else for that matter, you can now also use your fists as weapons. It might take a few punches, but it can work as a last resort to take a guard out. 

[h3]Dart gun[/h3]
To help you with Non-lethal takedown you will now be granted access to use the Dartgun. More information about this weapon is further down in this post. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/15da6b74202505a07f6786549ddc431ac9f92649.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3089cc673a0aacb857a12ec07b0ff0f89a86973b.png[/img]

[h1]Added: End/score screen[/h1]

One of the many reworks in the update will be focused on the end screen and scoring system. A true stealth game can only work if there are enough incentives to play the game in a stealthy matter. Before this was not the case. The goal was to get the case, in any way possible, and running and shooting was the best and easy way to do this. That is why we changed up the scoring system and added extra additional objectives that will reward you extra bonus exp and money if you take a stealth approach. There are a set amount of new objectives that give you badges on completion and you will earn a final score in the form of a medal. 

[h3]Bonus objectives[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Secondary Objectives[/b] - Complete all secondary objectives 
[*] [b]No Alarms raised[/b] - Set no alarms off
[*] [b]Never detected[/b] - Never be fully detected by security
[*] [b]No kills [/b]- Don’t kill any guards
[*] [b]Leave no Trace[/b] - Don’t leave any bodies or broken security systems behind to be discovered. 
[*] [b]Ghost [/b]- Complete all 5 Bonus objectives 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/92948d67db41d74a9b431945238c83f0919fba70.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/aa0e8fc874aa8d38b5d1a1aa88d8a04068b12703.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Slow-motion Mode[/h1]

This update also sees the return of slow-motion or bullet time. With the press of the right secondary action button, you can slow down time for a limited amount of energy. In slow-motion everything will be slower except for your hand movement, giving you more time to aim for that perfect headshot, or take down multiple guards in quick succession. New to slow-motion is that it takes up suit energy. Which can be tracked by a new tracker on your right wrist. After use it takes some time to recharge your bullet-time ability, so use it wisely.  

[b]Details[/b] 
[list]
[*] [b]New BulletTime/Slow-motion mode[/b]
[*] [b]Start slow motion with the Secondary Action button on the right controler[/b] 
[*] [b]Takes up Suit energy and has a cooldown time [/b] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/fd7e7d1a3a2aaeba66bae07bbff9a52bfb7c2e15.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Various Improvements[/h1]

One thing we did in addition to the rework was a small update to the visuals of the game. We updated the shaders, lighting, textures, and materials for the game. This visual update adds more depth to the environment and brings an extra touch of realism to the style of the game. Here are some screenshots which show the difference in style. We are looking forward to improving it even more in a future update.

[*] [b]Interface polish[/b]

[h1]Added: Dartgun [GADGET][/h1]

We are adding one of our personal favorite stealth-game gadgets: the Dartgun. This dart gun serves as a non-lethal gadget to silently take down guards. This air pressured devices fires a sleep dart to tranquilize a guard of your choice. Since it is a gadget that uses very specialized ammunition you can only use a set amount from the beginning of the mission.  (This amount will be upgradeable in a later update)  Guards hit by this dart will fall asleep and don’t count as a kill. Simply reload the Dartgun by pulling back the slide, and keep the dart drop-off rate and travel time in account when picking a target. 

[b]Gadget Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Fires non-lethal sleep  darts[/b]
[*] [b]A certain amount of bullets to use in each mission[/b]
[*] [b]Slower travel time and bullet drop-off[/b]
[*] [b]Needs to be reloaded after every shot[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/59b97a0591aee9d3bf874f937957be206c957bc5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/1401af974bf98cc8347471993ed156dfb48507e4.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Lockpicking [MECHANIC][/h1]

A stealth game would not be complete without lockpicking. It was one of the first things we had in our Kickstarter Demo, but now is returning with the 0.1.2 update! With this new mechanic, the player will be able to pick locks with their new lockpick set. These locks can be found on strongboxes, which spawn randomly around the whole level.

Just walk up to a lockbox and grab the lockpick to start the lockpicking. Now it is up to the player to find the right spot by twisting and turning the Lockpick. Once you find the hotspot with audio/visual/rumble cues, you can press the trigger to unlock the lock and open the strongbox. However be careful with the lockpick, if you go too fast you might miss the right spot, and your lockpick will break.

We also want to make sure that lockpick will always be optional, as like every stealth option in the game. You are not required to pick these strong boxes, but you will be well rewarded if you succeed.

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b] Added Lockpicking system[/b] 
[*] [b] Added Lockboxes in heist locations[/b]
[*] [b] Added High value loot to be found in Lockboxes[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Added: Lockers and Crates [ITEM][/h1]

With the new Stealth and AI system, it will always be possible to hide from enemy sight. In order to provide you with new ways to sneak away, we are introducing lockers and crates. Scattered around the level you can find these (very convenient) empty crates and lockers. Which are also the right size to hide an infiltrating agent or a guard’s body inside. So make use of these crates and lockers and take your stealth game to the next level. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Lockers and crates on set locations[/b]
[*] [b]Use it to hide from guards[/b]
[*] [b]Or use it to hide bodies and other items[/b]
[*] [b]Don’t get seen while entering the lockers[/b] (They are not bulletproof)

[h1]Added: Ammo Lockers [ITEM][/h1]

Ammo can be very important sometimes. In the previous version of the game, it was very difficult to find new ammo once you run out. That is why we are also adding Ammo lockers to the game. These lockers can randomly be found around the heist location and always contain ammo for your weapon. You can lock pick these Ammo lockers to gain access to new ammo. [h1]A New start for Panther VR![/h1]

Hi Everyone,

It has been a strange year for us all. The world is still different than it was one year ago,[b] but after months of hard work, we can finally reveal the new and first update (0.1.1) for Panther VR! The Interaction update includes a lot of system reworks, fixes, performance updates, and even some new features and mechanics![/b] It has been quite the ride for our 2 man team these past few months, but we are proud of what we have achieved and we can’t wait to see what you think! 

[b]Panther VR is still our passion project and we have so many ideas for the future of the game, like new mechanics, levels, weapons, gadgets, security systems, etc. [/b]We would love to maybe explore the possibility of co-op or to bring the game to the Quest. (but that is a future talk for now). So you must imagine that 2020  started great after the Kickstarter for Panther VR! While we were extremely grateful that we could start working on this project, the whole Covid situation quickly changed that forecast. It put a big strain on our workforce and budget. The whole situation forced our hand to bring Panther VR to Steam Early Access last year.

While we were happy that we could finally bring Panther VR to the public last year, the release left us with a bad taste. [b]We were not satisfied with the state and quality of the game on our first EA release, and it did not bring to life what we had in mind for the game. [/b]Sure, the general gameplay was present, but the controller and interaction (the basic foundation of a VR game) was broken and incomplete. So we quickly made a plan for ourselves after that initial release. 

Instead of working on a new update to add more content to an incomplete foundation, we wanted to start over with a clean slate as you would say. [b] To bring Panther to a higher quality level for VR as you would see in current VR titles.[/b] So we began a long journey to remake Panther to a level that we are proud of, and is worthy of our amazing community. While Covid did not make things easier for us, and it took more time than expected, we pushed onward and we are ready to give you this first update for Panther VR!

The interaction update brings a[b] full rework of the interaction [/b]with the world around you, with new and improved hands and animation. Move, run, crouch, and vault with the [b]new Movement system[/b]. Store items and gadgets in your backpack, and weapons on your belt with the[b] new Inventory system. [/b]Reload your weapons with the new[b] physical reloading and ammo system.[/b] Get yourself started in the game with the[b] new introduction and tutorial level.[/b] Plus many more: [b]like performance increases, Spectator camera, and new headset supports including Quest 2 for PC.[/b]

[b]We want to thank you all for your patience and amazing support for this project. This first update will be a new start for Panther VR! [/b]It has so much potential and we believe in an amazing future for this project! 2021 will be a lot better with more amazing new content and updates after this fresh new update!

Have fun!

[b]-Wolfdog Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]Why did it take longer than expected?[/h1]

[h3]- Covid Situation[/h3]
The lockdowns and curfews took a big toll on our development process. The whole dev process was forced on a pause for almost a month, and when we were finally able to work from home, it did not make things a lot easier.

I myself tested positive for covid in late October and was forced into complete isolation for almost a month. I’m really grateful that my symptoms were not so severe, but recovery took some time. 

[h3]- Total rework of everything we got[/h3]
We removed the old interaction system, and build and integrated a new one from the ground up. Work that was necessary for the future of the game. We could not build the whole game on the old broken system, so a new system was required for future updates and we added some new mechanics in the process as well. In Addition to the big rework, we also updated the engine of the game. 

[h3]- Small team of 2 People[/h3]
our team only consists of 2 people. While we have a lot of people surrounding and supporting us, the real work comes down to just the two of us. (including me) We broke down the plans into “smaller’ steps in our roadmap. But even these smaller steps take a lot of time with 2. Especially the huge amount of rework we did for this new update. 


[h3]- Some side jobs[/h3]
We are not a large company with unlimited resources. So we needed to do some small side jobs to keep working on this passion project possible. There are still bills that need to be paid.  We wish could work full time on this project, and we still hope that this will change in the future. :)

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2919985155802467583]Panther VR - Dev Blog 10# [Upcoming Update][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[h1] What is coming for the future?[/h1]
Now that this first update is up and running we can finally focus on the future of Panther VR. Since the moment we started this project our list of stuff and content we wanted to see for this game kept growing. And with this new foundation to the game, we can start to look at that long list and bring new content and mechanics to the game! Our goal is to bring more frequent updates to Panther VR this year!

[h3]Next update: 0.1.2 Security Update[/h3]
After we did a full rework on the interaction, there is still one big part of the game that we would love to change up. The guard AI and the way the different detection levels are handled are on the top of your priority list. The guards in the current version of the game are still using an old and dumbed-down AI system. In this next update, we want to rework how detection works, making guards more independent by bringing out their own search parties and giving the option to return a full alert back to normal with different and more steps between not detected and full alert. More information about this in an upcoming dev blog!

[h1]Added: Interaction System [REWORK] [/h1]

Interaction is core for any VR game. That is was missing the most in the first version of Panther VR. That is why we did a full overhaul of the interactions system. We removed the old clunky arms and replaced them with responsive hands. 

One of the biggest changes however is the item interaction. You are now able to fully grasp the items you pick up. Every item has its unique pose while grabbing, so no more floating items or strangely placed fingers. We’ve also added full physics to each item, so you will be able to knock stuff over or build small towers out of soda cans. It is still possible to grab objects once your hands are near them, but we also reworked the ranged system as well. Complimented by a GUI and hover over the indicator, items will now float smoothly into your hands once you grab them from a distance.

[h1]Added: Inventory System[/h1]

Introducing: the Backpack! The Backpack serves as a physical inventory system in which you can store items, melee weapons, and Loot. The Backpack is located behind your head and can be grabbed by holding down the grip button.

Inside your Backpack you can find a certain amount of slots for Items and melee weapons, sorted into different tabs. You can bring all small items with you, including Melee weapons and loot. So next time you come across a guard, there might be something very useful in your backpack.

We also included a Quick store and Auto store function for the backpack. When you grab the backpack, you can also put items in the auto slot at the top which are automatically stored in the first empty slot. For even more convenience you can also use the Quick store function. Without holding the backpack, you can just grab and put an item behind your head to automatically store it in your backpack!

[h1]Added: Movement System [REWORK] [/h1]

We have reworked our movement systems to smooth out the old system, and we added additional systems like running, vaulting, and crouching. Making it easier to navigate around.

[h3]Running[/h3]
We now added the option to sprint. YOu can move faster by pushing both the thumbstick forward. At this time you can sprint indefinitely and without making a sound. But this will change in the future.

[h3]Vaulting[/h3]
You can now vault over or jump on waist height objects. It uses the same controls as running, making it also possible to quickly vault over stuff while running.

[h3]Crouching[/h3]
In addition, to actually physically crouching down, we also added the option to press to auto crouch. This will lower the player to crouch height, making it easier to move through air vent or to hide behind cover, without crouching yourself. You can press on the thumbstick to crouch down.

[h1]Added: Weapon Interaction[/h1]

Based on our own experience in the game and on a lot of feedback from the community we decided to give this system a full overhaul. While the old system was more fast-paced, we are moving to a more “realistic approach” with a physical weapons system. All your weapons will be stored on your body/belt and the quick select system will be removed from the game. We have added 2 belt slots (left/right) for small firearms, and a large weapon slot on your back/ You can quickly draw and store your gun and Rifle. 

Next up is physical reloading and handling. Then you need to grab a new clip from your ammo belt (instead of moving the weapon to your belt) and physically put the new mag in your weapon. Once inserted, you need to pull back the slide of your weapons to put a bullet in the chamber. You can eject a mag or cock your gun whenever you want.

In the old version of Panther, you were instantly thrown into the game without any information whatsoever on what to do or who you are. That is why we are adding a Tutorial level. This level serves as an introduction to the story and the game for first-time players. 

When you start the game for the first time after this update, you will go through the introduction. This consist of the following things:

[h3]First-time Setup[/h3]
We have added a first-time setup screen in order to select your movement preference for the game. This will make the available options more present and will let you choose how you want to play the game. It is an easy and quick setup with information on different playstyles. There will also be a tutorial/training session that will teach you all about the current mechanics of the game. Each step will learn how you use your weapons, how security works, and how to complete a mission. So that when you start your first heist, you know what to expect! This also introduces you to our new ingame character: Z, the Hacker of the Crew (voiced by Joe Goffney)

notes.title: Panther VR - Dev Blog 10# [Upcoming Update]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/bb211866b6be02b75d3292de0a72eef68c5342b2.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Hope you are all still safe and sound. It has been some hectic and eventful months for all of us. While it has been a while that we posted a dev post, we are very eager to share with you some more information about our progress and status!

In the previous dev blogs, we discussed some new features and mechanics we are adding to the game with the new update. However in this new dev blog, we will share some more insight into the development process of the new update, and why it is taking longer than expected. We will also share some more information about the 0.1.1 update that is coming up soon, and to wrap it all up, we have some small new stuff to show and tease!


First of all, let’s talk about the development process of the new update. Since the release in July, we have been working really hard on the first big update. While we received a lot of positive feedback and suggestions since the release, we personally were not fully satisfied with the status of the game. 2020 already started as a mess, and the whole covid situation forced our hands to aim for an Early Access release in July. While we did everything we could to wrap things up for EA release, it still did not meet our high demands we set for ourselves and the community. So immediately after release, we set up a roadmap and a plan to work toward that version of Panther VR that we all want to see. We can tell with full certainty that we are still fully motivated to reach that goal, and the 0.1.1 update will be the first big step in the right direction! However, reaching that goal will take some time and it’s that development time I want to talk about. Because why is the new update taking so long? 
We will share some points about our process that will hopefully answer that question.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]Why is the Update taking longer than expected?[/h1]

[h2]Covid-19[/h2]
So let’s start with the elephant in the room: the covid situation. [b]While we are very lucky that everybody close to us is still healthy, and we also hope that everyone reading this and their relatives are also safe and sound. [/b]The whole of 2020 has been a year with a lot of downsides. The lockdowns took a big toll on our development process. The whole dev process was forced on a pause for almost a month, and when we were finally able to work from home, it did not make things a lot easier. Working on a game project is a very creative process, and working separately does not improve the situation. 

If that wasn’t enough,[b] I myself tested positive for covid in late October and was forced into complete isolation for 2 weeks.[/b] I’m really grateful that my symptoms were not so severe, but let just say that my bed was my best friend for that period. I’m fully recovered now, and really glad that I did not spread the virus to anyone else. So while we had a bit of a setback this year with covid, it never broke our spirit and we still kept working on the game.

[h2]Big first update[/h2]
One of the main reasons we were not satisfied with the 0.1.0 version of Panther VR is the interaction system. The hands were really awkward, there was no real interaction with the world. Items float in your hands and the fingers did not even move right. And let’s not start about the horrible inflatable noodle arms. Needless to say, it was time for a good rework. So that is what we did. [b]We removed the old interaction system, and build and integrated a new one from the ground up.[/b] This completely broke the player’s character and everything that the player could interact with: guards, security, etc. Meaning that almost every system in the game has to be partially reworked as well. You might imagine that took a lot of extra work. Work that was necessary for the future of the game. We could not build the whole game on the old broken system, so a new system was required for future updates and we added some new mechanics in the process as well. While it took a lot of extra time, we are very happy with the results we also shared in previous dev posts. It gives a whole new feeling to the game and brings Panther VR to a level you might expect of current VR games.  

[b]In Addition to the big rework, we also updated the engine of the game. [/b]When the production of Panther VR started, we built it in an older version of the Unity engine. During the dev process, they made a large update to that engine with a lot of improvements to VR optimization. This rework allowed us to update the engine as well. This update process broke the whole VR implementation to that game, and that needed some rework as well. It should improve the FPS for a lot of systems and it will implement support for all major HMDs. 

[h2]Small Team[/h2]
While the update required a lot of work, we can do so much each month with the team we have. We wanted to work with a bigger team on Panther VR, but due to Covid and limited resources, [b]our team only consists of  2 people.[/b] While we have a lot of people surrounding and supporting us, the real work comes down to just the two of us. (including me) We still have some big plans for Panther VR, and we are still looking at options to expand our production size. In the meantime, we broke down the plans into “smaller’ steps in our roadmap. But even these smaller steps take a lot of time with 2. Especially the huge amount of rework we did for this new update. We can only hope that the next updates will proceed faster and will feature fewer amounts of pandemics. 


So hopefully that shines a light on why it took a bit longer than expected. If we had a bigger team, we would have loved to give you the update a lot sooner. But we want to make sure that we are doing things the right way. And while it will take some extra time and a few more updates to get Panther VR where we want it to be, I’m sure it will be worth the wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3f68d4866177a3ea9917da94cee6809e65dbea7d.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[h1]Upcoming update[/h1]

Speaking of the new update. We can also share that we are getting really close now. [h1]Welcome to Panther VR Early Access![/h1]

Hi Everyone,

We hope you are all safe and well.

With great pleasure, we want to welcome you all to the Panther VR early Access! After a successful Kickstarter campaign and months of hard work, we can finally release the first Early Access version of Panther VR to the public.

First of all, we want to thank all of our Backers and our amazing community for testing the game and providing us with a lot of positive feedback and support. Now the time has come to release Panther VR to the public and to start our Early Access adventure together with our community. The 0.1.0 Version contains the base mechanics of the game to showcase our vision and future direction of the game. You can start a randomly generated mission from your hideout, use weapons and gadgets to evade security, go full stealth or guns blazing to get to the objective, find loot hidden all around the heist locations. 

Panther VR aims to bring the stealth-action genre to VR. We want to have a high focus on sandbox mechanics. For the player to discover their own route in open levels, choose their own playstyle with different approaches, and to play with the environment, gadgets, and weapons to aid them in their heists. All current and future content is added with a sandbox in mind and is largely based on feedback and suggestions from our community. 

We have huge plans for Panther VR, and a big list of content, reworks, and ideas for future updates. While we are super happy that Panther VR is finally open for the public, we also want to add, that this is still a VERY EARLY version of Panther VR. While the base game is present and we are very proud of what we have made already, it might still be a bit rough around the edges at some points and the game may contain some bugs. Please keep this in mind when buying the game, but if you do decide to check it out, it will help us out to improve the game immensely and hope you will see our vision and love for the game. If you want to help us out even more: you can share your feedback and suggestions with us in the Discord, together we can make this game into something amazing!

Thank you all so much for supporting the game and we hope you will enjoy this journey with us!

Have fun!

[b]-Wolfdog Team[/b]

We made a roadmap of the upcoming updates to let you know what you can expect from the first content Patches. There are currently 4 updates on this roadmap, but these are just the first of many, and the roadmap will extend in the future. Please check out our Panther VR roadmap to see what kind of new content we want to add in future updates:

[h1]Added: The Hideout [MAIN HUB][/h1]

The Guild provided your crew with their own Hideout. This secret base of operations is located in an abandoned warehouse and is repurposed with the following high tech equipment: An operation center for planning your missions, an armory for your weapons and gadgets, and a garage for your escape Vehicle. It will also be a perfect place to relax between dangerous missions.

The player Hideout will serve as the main hub of the game, you'll start your game in the hideout and it will be the location where you'll select your missions in the operation center. Since it is still an early version of the game, your hideout will only contain the mission selection screen, but many more functionalities will be included in later updates, such as a functional armory for weapon and gadget customization.

[b]Functionality:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Operations Center:[/b] Select missions (more functions added in future updates)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/70454b535de8584330034f21f26ea1da4383d44c.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Facility N4 [HEIST][/h1]

Welcome to Facility N4, a research facility located between the mountains and in a dense forest. This highly secured location is the home of many secret experiments, ranging from the creation of pharmaceutical samples to the productions of weapon prototypes. Its large open laboratory is crowded with security, but the machines and canisters should provide enough cover for our agent. Gain access through the loading dock, or go straight for the Main Lobby. Make sure you don’t forget to explore the offices for useful items and loot.  

Facility N4 is one of the first Heist locations in the game. Let me explain what a heist location means for the game. When you select a mission, it will take place at a heist location. These are prebuilt open-world locations. This means that the location will look the same, however, your selected mission will change a lot of variables at this level. Security will be in different locations, start and end locations will be different, loot will spawn in different locations, etc. Each heist location is also designed as a fully open level. You can always choose your own path and approach for each time you play a heist. 

With the combination of level randomization, and open level design, each level will have countless combinations and approaches and a high replayability factor. 

[b]Notible level locations:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Laboratory[/b]
[*] [b]Loading Dock[/b]
[*] [b]Visitors lobby[/b]
[*] [b]Research offices[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/b2b88a598fe121ab5443f4fa18aa10f68b2f908b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/dd3d91605ca78b76f82bc93f2c61fef20fb0dabb.png[/img]

[h1]Added: First Heists [MISSIONS][/h1]

In a distant future, ruled by international Corporations, there is always a struggle for power. Most power can be bought with money, everything else can be stolen. This is where the “Guild” comes into place. An international secret organization of master thieves, working for the highest bidder.  These companies are always interested in obtaining prototypes, samples, or top-secret documents from their competitors. That is where you come in.

You can take on missions provided by the Guild. They can be selected in the Hideout. The first missions you can play are Heists. A Heist always has one primary Objective: steal the main object. This sounds easy on paper, but the main objective is always locked in a secure room. So your first goal is to gain access to this secured room. This can be done in two distinct ways: 

[b]1) STEALTH [/b]The first is the stealth approach. You can choose to complete two secondary objectives to gain access to the vault. The first and only secondary objective currently in the game is to override power to the vault door. More variants will be added in later updates, for example: hacking a terminal. Once these secondary objectives are completed, the vault door will unlock and the main objective will be for the taking. 

[b]2) LOUD [/b]You can also choose a more direct and loud approach. Instead of completing the secondary objectives, you can also place a lasercutter on the vault door. This lasercutter will gradually cut a hole in the door, but it will also trigger the built-in security system, which will sound the alarm. To be on the lookout for incoming armed forces, and try to protect the lasercutter al all cost. When a hole is cut with your lasers, your final barrier will be gone, and the objective can be looted. 

[quote=] [b]Developer Comment:[/b] While the stealth approach is always the first and suggested way to go, (netting you more rewards in later updates), the more forceful approach is also needed when the alarm is triggered in stealth approach, and you didn’t complete the secondary objectives. Once you obtained the primary objective, it is time to head to the Getaway van. Each Heist will be randomly generated and is sorted on difficulty.  In the current version, there are 2 (random) generated test missions before we integrate a fully-fledged mission system in a later update. [/quote]

[b]Heist Structure:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Primary objective: [/b]Secured in Vault. Vault can be opened by completing secondary objectives (Stealth) or with a lasercutter (loud)

[*] [b]Secondary objective:[/b] Override power to the vault (optional)

[*] [b]Escape:[/b] Bring the main objective back to the Escape van. 
[/list]

[b]Mission Randomization[/b] (All things random in a mission)

[list]
[*] [b]Start locations [/b]
[*] [b]Loot and item locations[/b] 
[*] [b]Secondary Objectives locations[/b] 
[*] [b]All security locations[/b] 
[*] [b]Escape Locations[/b] 
[/list]

[h1]Added: Movement Options [SYSTEM][/h1]

Everybody has its own preference when it comes to movement in VR. That is why we already added a variety of movement options to choose from. For your main movement, you can choose between movement with the stick, or our own “Arm Swing” system. (Same as in VR Dungeon Knight). For turning you can pick between smooth turning, and snap turning and they all can be calibrated with different speeds and snap angles. 

[b]Movement options[/b] 

[list]
[*] [b]Smooth movement: Move forward with Stick[/b]
[*] [b]Armswing movement: Move with forward by swinging you arms[/b] 
[*] [b]Turning Options: Smooth turning [/b] (Different speeds)
[*] [b]Turning Options: Snap Turning[/b] (Differen angles)
[/list]

[h1]Added: GOHL-S [WEAPON][/h1]

Introducing the Gohl-s. The Gohl is the standard issue handgun for all Guild Agents. This all-round handgun is always a good choice on a mission. Especially if you equip them with the silencer, it becomes a fast, deadly and silent solution for taking down guards.

[b]Weapon statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Comes equipped with a silencer[/b] (weapons modification added in future update)
[*] [b]Very useful for stealth approach[/b]
[*] [b]Fast fire[/b]
[*] [b]Normal range[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/ae7eca822a90cabc7bf0d3602d28741efd3318f3.png[/img]


[h1]Added: FELDT M33 [WEAPON][/h1]

When a plan does not work out as expected and you need to engage in full combat, the Feldt will be your best friend. This Guild-issued assault rifle comes with a good fire rate and a decent-sized magazine. Equipped with Iron sights, it can be precise on a good range. This assault rifle can be held with both hands.

[b]Weapon statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Can be wielded with both hands[/b] 
[*] [b]Very useful for Loud approach[/b]
[*] [b]Very Fast fire[/b]
[*] [b]Normal range[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f5468afb9398e2c20ca99951ba4cc3d115d39ec9.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Grappling Hook [GADGET][/h1]

A good item for traversal is important for any thief. Use the grappling hook to get yourself up too hard to reach locations. You can find hooks and ledges scattered around the heist location. Shoot a rope from a distance and climb up on the rooftops. The grappling gun grants access to new routes and different approaches. 

[b]Gadget statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Shoot a climbing rope from a distance[/b]  (More functions added in future update)
[*] [b]Opens up new routes[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/8ddbb4f0e951997ab20cb5cb5c3572ff10f5ce9f.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Scout Drone [GADGET][/h1]

The more you know about your surroundings, the better. Make use of the Scout drone, and scout ahead before entering. It’s a small two-wheeled drone and comes equipped with a camera. The scouting drone can reach new places through small vents and can mark guard locations with its camera. The drone cannot be spotted by security, so it very useful for gathering intel. 

[b]Gadget statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Use the drone to scout ahead[/b]  (More functions added in future update)
[*] [b]Marks guards[/b]
[*] [b]Can go through small vents[/b]
[*] [b]Can be used to hack Security Routers[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/59b97a0591aee9d3bf874f937957be206c957bc5.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f9f52bb465d82c4fd351245c46a785b440e65302.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Loot [COLLECT][/h1]

Exploration is key as a Thief. Take a good look around during your heist to find many useful and valuable items. I’m sure nobody will miss their valuable belongings right? Scattered around the heist locations you can find loot. Pick them up and sell them for a good profit. Some extra money, above the initial mission awards, will always come in handy. 


[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Find randomized loot all across the level[/b] 
[*] [b]Gain some extra cash for what you collect[/b]
[*] [b]Loot comes with a different value[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/eacc23333567a57c40fac9f20b567e5fe9f8554c.png[/img]


[h1]Added: (Non)Lethal Weapons [ITEM][/h1]


Your own weapons aren't the only ones that can be useful during your heist. If you are creative enough you can use some items you find throughout the heist locations. A pointy screwdriver can be a deadly throwing weapon in the right hands, and the guard will take a good nap after a kiss to the face from a wrench. You can use items as lethal weapons to dispatch guards in creative methods. (non-lethal takedowns will be added in a future update)

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Find items during a heist to use as a weapon[/b] 
[*] [b]Use a screwdriver as a deadly throwing weapon[/b]
[*] [b]Hit a guard unconscious with a heavy wrench[/b] (more items will be added in a future update)
[*] [b]Blow up propane canisters[/b] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/7b0a4bc5d71a7945bb98cff737745f7875fc51fc.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Climbing/vents [ENVIRONMENT][/h1]

When you run into an obstacle during your heist, you might need to look for a different route. Use rain pipes, ladders, and ropes to take the high road to your objective. Large air vents may also prove useful to navigate around the location, it is also a good place to hide, for when the guards start looking around. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Use pipes, ladders and ropes to climb[/b] 
[*] [b]Sneak inside with the use of an Airvent[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f2acb6ff5617cae6156377f59653acfc08e2ece8.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Cardboard Box [ITEM][/h1]

Sometimes, the best place to hide is in plain sight. We got a Solid tip from a very experienced agent that a cardboard box will do the trick. I’m sure there must be some boxes laying around you can use. The key is to stay very quiet and don’t move. The guard won’t blink an eye from a distance, but they might be suspicious from a shorter range.

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hide in a Cardboardbox[/b] 
[*] [b]Sneaky like a snake[/b]
[*] [b]Don’t move![/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/69c46205b30145288d5dae830434c65e449f7bb2.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/cf60ae2e3e02334b4b2646e162877c38408a0879.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Security Guard [GUARD][/h1]

Müller international security [MSec] is responsible for the protection and security of high priority locations. They enlist and deploy trained security guards to patrol around important targets. Be on the lookout for these guards. They follow a strict patrol route, but they will also investigate anything suspicious. When they find something that confirms their suspicion they will call out for backup, or even sound the alarm. Do your best to avoid these guards, and only use force if necessary. If so, try to hide the body if you can. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Avoid detection[/b] 
[*] [b]Patrols a set route[/b] (A.I will be reworked in future update)
[*] [b]Will investigate anything suspicious[/b]
[*] [b]Can be taken out[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/dbb0d00af37fd6d6b98f593b557a0cc615fad492.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Heavy Guard [GUARD][/h1]

When a normal Security guard doesn’t suffice, bring in the Heavy Guards. These Heavy guards are all padded up, and come equipped with bulletproof helmets, which prevents headshots. They can take a lot more damage than normal security guards, so try to avoid them at all costs. However, if you can get close enough, a well-placed screwdriver might do the trick. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Armored, can take a lot of damage[/b] 
[*] [b]Patrols a set route[/b]
[*] [b]Will investigate anything suspicious[/b]
[*] [b]Vulnerable for melee. [/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a34ac935685b336707e7b96f8876e50794c3be53.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Security Camera [SEC SYSTEM][/h1]

Security cameras are the first line of defense. They can be found all over the location, and they always scan for anything suspicious. Close track their movement and locations, and try to stay out of their sight. They won’t detect noise, and a well-timed shot can take them out of service. However, guards aren’t so keen on finding broken security systems. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]On the lookout for intruders[/b] 
[*] [b]Won't detect noise[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/60cdb53f9f1af84a3226f9155a0759e6205e9e1c.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Laserfence [BASIC SEC][/h1]

A very efficient and common security system is the Laser fence. These strategically placed fences are used to keep intruders out. Small points emit painful lasers to form a large grid, to block off a certain route. The lasers are calibrated on the presence of Guards and SWAT, which will make them immune to the effect of the lasers. However, if an intruder touches the laser grid, they will receive a painful shock, and the gate will sound a short alarm for any surrounding guards.  

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Blocks route for intruders[/b] 
[*] [b]Very painfully when touched[/b]
[*] [b]Calibrated to Guards and Police[/b]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 5#: Get ready for Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/dc8cdc37036ba9d508b3470f964404c776a56481.png[/img]
[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1]

Once again, we hope that you are all safe and healthy. With great joy we can share some more news on the Early Access release of Panther VR. We got a lot of positive feedback from the ALPHA and BETA, and we can't wait to share the game with the rest of the world. So without further ado, lets me explain our release schedule for Panther VR and what we have planned after release. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolfdogint/panther-vr/posts]For the last Dev updates, Please check out our Kickstarter page.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/dbd12372f3f6e722553434f0acc3023259b1858b.png[/img]


First of all, we want to thank you all for your patience, trust, and positivity during the COVID situation. While it still a strange time for us all, we can look back at some very exciting weeks working on the game, and we are very pleased with the results of the ALPHA and BETA. We are still working on some last fixes from the BETA, but it is nearing its Early Access stage. It just needs a little more time in the oven to smooth some mechanics out behind the scenes, but it now only a matter of days, so we are talking about: very soon. 

The first Launch of a game is an important moment, one that should be taken with great care but it also brings some important opportunities. Besides making the game ready for our Kickstarter backers and the general public, it is also the time to make sure that a lot of our backers get their rewards and it gives us a new moment for marketing. We are very proud of what we created so far, so we also want to take the opportunity to make Panther VR know to a larger audience. We need a couple of days to make sure that all remaining Kickstarter Backers will receive their EA key,  and that the marketing is all set to go. There is also a small optimization update we want to make to improve the performance of the game. [b]Due to these small additions we want to propose the following release schedule that we divided for Backers and non-Backers.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3179e3331d4e997f270d0e20d5b01f65bb4824e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/83adff1fe257eb8d51522bfe2feb1683d279eb78.png[/img]

[h1][b]For Backers[/b][/h1]

[i][h3]Applies if you are a Kickstarter Backer[/h3][/i]

The ALPHA and BETA has been a huge success. Thanks to the feedback, and bug report from the community, We could address and fix a lot of small community reported bugs and issues. However, one important thing still required our attention: Performance. This is why we want to collect more data on this before we release it to the public, we decided to ask the remaining Backers to help us out on with this.

[b]This means that we will release Panther VR to all backers as soon as the build is ready to test at the end of May/ First week of June! [/b]See it as an Early Early Access version. Looking at how the backers have been waiting with a lot of excitement, we don't want to keep you guys waiting any longer. So keep an eye on your email these days for an Early Access key of Panther VR and some small instructions to help us out on the performance part. We can't wait to hear what you think, and thanks again for all your support!

[b][h1]Public[/h1][/b]
[i][h3]Applies if you aren't a Kickstarter Backer[/h3][/i]

Now that the Early access moment of Panther VR rapidly is approaching, it will be a moment that we look forward to with excitement. The build is almost ready, but we still need some extra time to test out the performance with our remaining backers before we can open it to the public. So it will be a short wait before we release Panther VR into the world.[b] We can't share an exact date just yet, but we will be announcing the release date at the UploadVR showcase, hosted by IGN  summer of Gaming on June 16th. So be sure to check it out for more information, but trust us and rest assured, you won't be disappointed with the date! ;)   [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/b0ae47a2af12513409699e915390df9fc7f12ffe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/0d006dcf703e850e01bc19642b8020bbdf478c8b.png[/img]


Once Panther VR goes live on Early Access, it also marks the beginning of our journey. This first version will contain the core mechanics of the game, but we have a large list of new content and improvements planned for many Early Access updates to come. Think of new weapons, gadgets, maps, mission types,  mechanics but also improvement of current systems, like our detection and interaction system. We will release a small roadmap with future content together with the Early Access release of Panther VR. For all the latest content updates and progress, make sure to check out our Panther VR tracking List.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/0a26ff51f839d46c1cd4de70cc1d138f4a940f3f.png[/img]


With the EA Release of Panther VR coming closer and closer, we want to talk a bit more about the retail price and our future plans surrounding it. 

Panther VR started its production since the start of 2018 and went through a successful Kickstarter campaign to fund a small portion of the development costs. We have a small but very dedicated team working on their dream project. The world is going through some strange and difficult times right now, but working on the game is such a relief, and seeing all your positive reactions is heartwarming to us all.   

Very soon, our Early access adventure will start with the first public release of Panther VR. The game will start with a solid base, a huge list of future content, and a lot of amazing community suggestions.  Looking at the current size of the game, but also at, what we think huge potential and future content we decided on the following price.

[b]Panther VR will cost 19.99 on Steam Early Access.[/b] We hope it will be a fair price to you all. The game is still in an Early Stage right now, but every sale will help us out a great deal and will allow us to keep improving the game with new content, missions, mechanics, weapons, gadgets, and community ideas! So we truly hope that you will be able to join us in the early stage of our adventure and stick around to see Panther VR grow into something amazing.

When the game will grow with future content and updates, we will come to a point that we decide to increase the base price as well.[b] Meaning that once the game is more fleshed out with updates, or hits it full 1.0 version (which will still be some time away), we will raise the base price to a more appropriate level.[/b] This will come in small increments, and will always come with a heads up before this happens. So joining us in an early stage of the game will have some benefits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/00d927d18d1ea604ae7f2909e34713eb46c90c62.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1]

Hope you are all safe and well. Normally we release a new dev update on Kickstarter, but this time we wanted to share some news on our Steam page as well. It has been a weird time for the whole world. It shows us even more that we all need to work together and stay positive for the future. While we are staying safe and following the instructions from our government, we are still fully continuing our work on Panther VR. In this update, we will tell you more about the already released Alpha Version of Panther VR and we will share some light on the current process of the game and future release dates of the Beta and Early Access versions of Panther VR. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolfdogint/panther-vr/posts]For the last Dev updates, Please check out our Kickstarter page.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/d347e3ec180ff0a5945c2ab729ac34f61fd1020e.png[/img]

In March we released the Alpha version of Panther VR for our Kickstarter Backers with the Operative Perk or higher. We have worked a long time for this first official public version, and we were looking forward to the launch of the Alpha.  It was a great opportunity to playtest the core mechanics and to collect a lot of precious feedback from the backers. 

Luckily a large majority of the Alpha backers had the opportunity to explore and test out the Alpha version of the Game. We received a lot of amazing and positive feedback and suggestions on the official Panther VR discord.  We also have sent out a survey to all Alpha players to collect even more details on their experiences. They did a great job of locating remaining bugs and glitches or test out the game on different HMD, controllers and computer setups. We are listening to every suggestion to make the game even better for the Beta and Early Access version. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolfdogint/panther-vr/posts/2739869]For more information about the Alpha content, please check out this last Dev update. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/83adff1fe257eb8d51522bfe2feb1683d279eb78.png[/img]

We also want to talk a bit more about the current COVID situation and how it has affected us and the development of Panther VR. First of all, we all hope that you are safe. The well being of our team and players is our first priority.  That is why we are following the guidelines set by our government. For those who might not know, our office is located in the Netherlands, which has issued, in what they call; intelligent lockdown. This means that our office is closed down since March and that everyone is working safely from home. As of this time of writing all team members and their relatives are still healthy.

While we are still working hard from our own homes, it is far from ideal. We truly love to work on Panther VR, it is truly a  passion project and after seeing the positive reaction from the Alpha, it made us even more excited for what is to come. Everyone's well being is the most important, but having such a huge passion for the game, It also pains us that the current situation has slowed down the development process. 

[b]This means that we need to delay the Beta to end of April/start of May and the Early Access version will follow shortly after that at the end of May. [/b]We really want to make something we are all proud of, and we are still doing the best we can with the limited resources we currently have.  We truly hope you will understand, and we wish everyone the best in these strange times. We will get through this, and we can't wait for the game to officially go live. If you have any more questions regarding this, or if you just want to share your thoughts with us, please check out the Panther VR discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3f68d4866177a3ea9917da94cee6809e65dbea7d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/b67a492f512bb4991034e6c9d422b0b0d077065d.png[/img]

There might be some small delays, but we are still making a good process on the Beta. While the main purpose of the Alpha was to test out the core mechanics, the beta is the moment to expand on those ideas.  Besides fixing bugs and glitches, we want to flesh out some core mechanics and test out the hideout. Our main job is to get the core of the game ready for Early Access. Once that goes live, we can start adding new content, levels, missions, weapons, gadgets etc. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolfdogint/panther-vr/posts/2739869]For more information about the Alpha content, please check out this last Dev update. [/url]

[h3]This is what you can expect from the Beta:[/h3]

[b]Fix Alpha Bugs:[/b] The Beta will improve on the Alpha. We will try to fix a lot of Bugs/ feedback and suggestions from the Alpha.

[b]Changes to the First Level: [/b]Based on feedback, playtesting and new content, we will update the current and first level of Panther VR. 

[b]More Level/mission randomization[/b]: We want to add more randomization to the level. New objective locations, guard routes, and new escape locations, in order to make the game feel even more different every time you play the game. 

[b]Physical interaction player:[/b] We reworked the player interaction system, to let the player physically interact with the world. This means that your hand, arms, and weapons will interact with the environment and won't clip through walls anymore. [Side Note: Some of you might have noticed it in the Alpha, but due to performance calibrations,  we turned off a lot of interactable items in the level (besides the wrench, screwdrivers, and loot). In future updates, we want to add a lot of interactable items in the level to play around with. Such as drawers, mugs, bottles, fire axes, office supplies etc.]

[b]Improvement of Laser security systems:[/b] Security routers will be added in the game that will control the laser fences. Giving you the opportunity to turn them off. 

[b]Ingame Menu:[/b] We are working on an ingame "pause" menu with a reset button and some settings to tinker with. 

[b]Adding the Hideout:[/b] The main purpose of the Beta is to test out the hideout. This hideout will serve as the main hub of the game, just like the Main Chamber does in VR Dungeon Knight. From this location, you will be able to choose your missions. More functionalities will be added in later updates, like Leveling systems, data drives, mission/contract systems, weapon load-outs, and weapon customization. Backer credits and Golden Plaque with Founders can also be found in this hideout.
